newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closes 2.3 higher at 1,058.90.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closes 2.3 higher at 1,058.90.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 2.35 higher versus the dollar at 1,058.90 in quiet trading on the interbank market, traders said.

They said importers were holding back on buying greenbacks and shipping new orders into the country in the hope that the government would have second thoughts about an increase in import tariffs announced last Thursday.
A decree formalizing the hike in tariffs has not been published yet.
Dealers reported 256 trades in Monday's session for a lower- than-average $114 million and said the peso held in a 1,058-to- 1,062 trading range.
